name: Conductor
where_agents_run: your Mac, or Conductor's cloud sandboxes (paid plans), which keep running after you close the app
license: Closed source; free, Pro $50/month, Teams $60 per user per month
source_note: Checked against conductor.build/llms-full.txt (all docs, pricing and FAQ pages), the homepage, the changelog index and the 0.77-0.89 release notes, the installer file sizes (v0.89.2), and a June 2026 engineering write-up on performance.dev for the app shell. No public source repo. Not installed or run here.

multi_provider_supervision.value: Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode side by side

harness_count.value: 4 in chat; Amp, Pi, Copilot, Gemini as terminal presets

needs_you_signal.value: Sidebar marks sessions that need input; completion sounds

approve_deny_prompt.value: Tool approvals answered in the chat, if turned on

cross_provider_delegation.value: Mixed agents in one workspace; hand-off only in cloud

conversation_gui_view.value: Chat view per tab, with plans and tool calls

real_terminal.value: Agent's own terminal in an experimental mode

session_organization.value: Sidebar of workspaces with sections and pins; tabs inside

saved_prompt_library.value: Slash commands and editable action prompts

builtin_editors_browser.value: Edit files in diffs, file viewer, browser previews

appearance_control.value: Light and dark modes, zoom; no font setting found

usage_hud.value: Claude and Codex account limits and resets

issue_tracker_pipeline.value: GitHub or Linear issue to workspace, PR, checks, merge

worktree_management.value: Every workspace is its own git worktree

planner_orchestrator.value: Plan Mode per chat; you split the work yourself

agent_to_agent_messaging.value: Agents can prompt other sessions via its MCP, cloud only

knowledge_base.value: Per-workspace .context folder for notes and hand-offs

native_mobile_app.value: iOS app marked Soon on its homepage

remote_ssh.value: Its own cloud machines over SSH; not your own hosts

os.value: macOS only (Apple silicon, Intel); Windows and Linux not yet

background_process.value: No: local agents stop when the app quits; cloud ones keep going

download_size.value: v0.89.2: 80 MB Apple silicon dmg, 86 MB Intel dmg

ram_vs_claude_desktop.value: Small (estimate: Tauri app on the system webview; idle agents shut down)

extensibility.value: HTTP API and MCP server (Pro, cloud), deep links

teams_multiuser.value: Shared cloud workspaces, live multiplayer, Teams plan

stability_maturity.value: v0.89.2, releases several times a week since July 2025
